notes.title: Awards and Our Heartfelt Thanks
notes.content:
[h1]Henchman Story is an Award Winner![/h1]

With the end of the year comes award season, and we're proud to say the Henchman Story won a couple of honors! First, we won Switchabo's 'Best Hidden Gem' Award!

[url=https://www.switchaboo.com/switchaboo-2021-game-of-the-year-awards/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38936934/56adaa48270d6eedf783f8870027ffa5812ab1d3.png[/img][/url]

And we also earned an Honorable Mention in the SwitchRPG Awards, where they had some lovely things to say about the game.

[url=https://switchrpg.com/articles/switchrpg-awards-2021-kierras-picks/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38936934/c662cce6f875d9111e7200ac0d92b367f2a7d940.png[/img][/url]

[quote]Henchman Story is the story of…well…a henchman. With an abundance of endings, CGs to unlock, and paths to take, it was fun to play as Stan the henchman as he made the best (or worst) choices of his life and seeing the consequences of said choices. The comic book inspiration is also a treat to take in.[/quote]

[h1]Thank You![/h1]

It's been nearly three months since Henchman Story launched on Steam, and as we enter a new year, all of us at Silken Sail just wanted to take a moment to thank each and every one of you for playing our game. We're overjoyed that it's brought laughter and fun to so many people, and each time we read a new Steam review or comment, it brightens our day.

We plan on making games under the Silken Sail banner for years to come, and it means the world to have your support. So to all you henchmen, heroes and villains out there - thank you, and let's have an amazing 2022 together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38936934/b9bb625df3ae8e8aca6c9f3844aa59dba28c9823.png[/img]

And don't forget to [url=discord.gg/5cqzStSssA]join us on the official Silken Sail Discord![/url]

notes.title: [Patch Notes] - Version 1.1
notes.content:
Greetings to all henchman, heroes and villains! Thank you all so much for the wonderful reception that you've given to Henchman Story since our launch last week. After monitoring player reviews, bug reports and testing the game internally, we've given the green light to Henchman Story's first ever patch.

Here's what we've changed:

[h2]UI Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Auto-Play has been moved from the Options Menu to the in-game Quick Menu.
[*]  Auto-Play Time has been added to the Options Menu. Increasing or decreasing this changes how long the pause is between each text box while Auto-Play is active.
[*] Text Speed has been added to the Options Menu. This lets you adjust how fast dialogue and narration appears in the text box. Setting it to maximum lets them appear instantly.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Workaround for a song that was not being properly unlocked in the Music Room (Baby, It's Showtime!). This song now unlocks when players complete 1 playthrough of the game. If you have already completed a playthrough, this will work retroactively, meaning you do not have to complete the game again to unlock the song.
[*] Fixed two instances where Madame Scorpion's VO repeated itself
[*] Fixed a line where the first part of Stan's VO was missing
[*] Fixed an instance of the wrong VO file playing for one of Stan's lines
[*] Various typo and punctuation fixes 
[*] Fixed a Music Room song icon that wasn't highlighted when the song was playing
[/list]

If you encounter any issues with the update or have any feedback to share, please use our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1449510/discussions/0/4580716151538768288/]Bug Report Form[/url] and [url=https://t.co/Fu4MO8Cpn8?amp=1]join us on the official Silken Sail Discord![/url]

notes.title: Henchman Story Releases on October 14th - New Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-BIpeei6pDU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Release Date[/h2]
It's official - [i]Henchman Story[/i] releases on Steam on [b]October 14th, 2021[/b] with support for PC, Mac and Linux. Check out our snazzy new announcement trailer above and be sure to wishlist us to get notified as soon as the full game is available.

[h2]New Demo[/h2]
As part of our release date announcement, we've relaunched Henchman Story's demo with full voice acting, our updated, original soundtrack, an extended ending and more. You can download it right here on Steam - where it will be available all the way through Steam Next Fest in October!

[h2]Steam Next Fest[/h2]
Speaking of Steam Next Fest, be sure to check back here once the festival starts - we'll be scheduling some live streams of our demo where you can interact with team and get some insight into the game's development.

Until then, enjoy the demo and stay tuned! We can't wait to show you the full release.

notes.title: Henchman Story: New Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38936934/c99f60ef341c87e5a191db90f5d25d03292c5283.png[/img]

Hi there, everyone! First, thank you so much to those who have added Henchman Story to your wishlist or downloaded our demo, we really appreciate all the support you've given the game so far.

If you fall in the later category, you may have noticed that we disabled Henchman Story's demo on Steam for now - but don't worry! It won't be missing from your Steam library for long, because very soon, Henchman Story will be getting a brand new, fully updated demo featuring:
[list]
[*] Full voice acting for every character
[*] The smooth sounds of Henchman Story's original soundtrack
[*] A slightly extended ending, and more![/list]
And once this brand new demo is released, keep your eye on this page, because we may have some even bigger news following right behind it...

So keep wishlisting and sharing the game! Big things are on the way!
